_comment: Root landing page. BigQuery figures are read from that project's own summary.json so the hero cannot drift from the committed sample data. The two toolkit figures are measured runs - see readme-assets.remap.json and readme-assets.descriptions.json for how.

hero.name: hero
hero.title: Power BI, as source code
hero.subtitle: A semantic model and report you can diff, a scripted month of synthetic data, and two tools that bulk-edit PBIR and TMDL files from a CSV.

tiles.label: field references repointed in one run
TMDL fields documented from one CSV

banners.name: section-observability
banners.title: BigQuery + dbt Cost Observability
banners.body: Where the warehouse spend went, and which dbt model, test or hook spent it. Ships a synthetic month, so it refreshes with no cloud account.

banners.name: section-remap
banners.title: PBIR Field Remap Toolkit
banners.body: Repoint every field reference in a report from one table or column to another, driven by a CSV. Inventory first, then one command, no flags to get wrong.

banners.name: section-descriptions
banners.title: Semantic Model Descriptions
banners.body: Load field descriptions into a TMDL model from a CSV, as the /// comments that surface as tooltips in Power BI Desktop.
